passages.text: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, in the month of Ziv, the second month of the fourth year of Solomon’s reign over Israel, he began to build the house of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled over Israel.
He was in the fourth year of his reign.
The Israelites had left Egypt four hundred and eighty years earlier.
It was the month of Ziv.
Ziv is the second month.
In that time, Solomon began to build the house of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י בִשְׁמוֹנִ֣ים שָׁנָ֣ה וְאַרְבַּ֣ע מֵא֣וֹת שָׁנָ֡ה לְצֵ֣את בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מֵאֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַיִם֩ בַּשָּׁנָ֨ה הָרְבִיעִ֜ית בְּחֹ֣דֶשׁ זִ֗ו ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י לִמְלֹ֥ךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּ֥בֶן הַבַּ֖יִת לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The house that King Solomon built for the LORD was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon built a house for the LORD.
This house was sixty cubits long.
It was twenty cubits wide.
It was thirty cubits high.
passages.original: וְהַבַּ֗יִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה שִׁשִּֽׁים־ אַמָּ֥ה אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים רָחְבּ֑וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אַמָּ֖ה קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The portico at the front of the main hall of the temple was twenty cubits long, extending across the width of the temple and projecting out ten cubits in front of the temple.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon built a temple for the LORD.
The temple had a main hall.
A portico stood in front of the main hall.
The portico was twenty cubits long.
It stretched across the full width of the temple.
The portico projected out ten cubits in front of the temple.
passages.original: וְהָאוּלָ֗ם עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ הֵיכַ֣ל הַבַּ֔יִת עֶשְׂרִ֣ים אַמָּה֙ אָרְכּ֔וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י רֹ֣חַב הַבָּ֑יִת עֶ֧שֶׂר בָּאַמָּ֛ה רָחְבּ֖וֹ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: He also had narrow windows framed high in the temple.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon built the temple for the LORD.
He made windows for the temple.
These windows were narrow.
He placed the windows high in the temple walls.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ לַבָּ֔יִת חַלּוֹנֵ֖י שְׁקֻפִ֥ים אֲטֻמִֽים׃

passages.text: Against the walls of the temple and the inner sanctuary, Solomon built a chambered structure around the temple, in which he constructed the side rooms.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
He built the temple in Jerusalem.
He built a structure against the walls of the temple.
He built this structure around the temple.
He built it around the main hall and the inner sanctuary.
He made side rooms in this structure.
He placed these side rooms all around the temple.
passages.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ עַל־ קִ֨יר הַבַּ֤יִת יָצוֹעַ סָבִ֔יב אֶת־ קִיר֤וֹת הַבַּ֙יִת֙ סָבִ֔יב לַֽהֵיכָ֖ל וְלַדְּבִ֑יר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ צְלָע֖וֹת סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: The bottom floor was five cubits wide, the middle floor six cubits, and the third floor seven cubits. He also placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple, so that nothing would be inserted into its walls.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He made three floors of side rooms around the temple.
The bottom floor was five cubits wide.
The middle floor was six cubits wide.
The third floor was seven cubits wide.
He placed offset ledges around the outside of the temple.
These ledges kept the side rooms from being attached to the temple walls.
passages.original: הַיָּצוֹעַ הַתַּחְתֹּנָ֜ה חָמֵ֧שׁ בָּאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבָּ֗הּ וְהַתִּֽיכֹנָה֙ שֵׁ֤שׁ בָּֽאַמָּה֙ רָחְבָּ֔הּ וְהַ֨שְּׁלִישִׁ֔ית שֶׁ֥בַע בָּאַמָּ֖ה רָחְבָּ֑הּ כִּ֡י מִגְרָעוֹת֩ נָתַ֨ן לַבַּ֤יִת סָבִיב֙ ח֔וּצָה לְבִלְתִּ֖י אֲחֹ֥ז בְּקִֽירוֹת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: The temple was constructed using finished stones cut at the quarry, so that no hammer or chisel or any other iron tool was heard in the temple while it was being built.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple.
He used finished stones.
Workers cut these stones at the quarry.
They did not cut or shape stones at the temple site.
No hammer was heard in the temple during construction.
No chisel was heard in the temple during construction.
No iron tool was heard in the temple during construction.
passages.original: וְהַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּהִבָּ֣נֹת֔וֹ אֶֽבֶן־ שְׁלֵמָ֥ה מַסָּ֖ע נִבְנָ֑ה וּמַקָּב֤וֹת וְהַגַּרְזֶן֙ כָּל־ כְּלִ֣י בַרְזֶ֔ל לֹֽא־ נִשְׁמַ֥ע בַּבַּ֖יִת בְּהִבָּנֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The entrance to the bottom floor was on the south side of the temple. A stairway led up to the middle level, and from there to the third floor.
passages.sermon:
The temple had three floors.
The bottom floor had its entrance on the south side of the temple.
A stairway started at the bottom floor.
The stairway led up to the middle floor.
From the middle floor, the stairway continued up to the third floor.
passages.original: פֶּ֗תַח הַצֵּלָע֙ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה אֶל־ כֶּ֥תֶף הַבַּ֖יִת הַיְמָנִ֑ית וּבְלוּלִּ֗ים יַֽעֲלוּ֙ עַל־ הַתִּ֣יכֹנָ֔ה וּמִן־ הַתִּֽיכֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it, roofing it with beams and planks of cedar.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon built the temple.
He finished building the temple.
He put a roof on the temple.
He used beams of cedar for the roof.
He used planks of cedar for the roof.
passages.original: וַיִּ֥בֶן אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּ֑הוּ וַיִּסְפֹּ֤ן אֶת־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ גֵּבִ֔ים וּשְׂדֵרֹ֖ת בָּאֲרָזִֽים׃

passages.text: He built chambers all along the temple, each five cubits high and attached to the temple with beams of cedar.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple.
He added chambers along every side of the temple.
Each chamber was five cubits high.
He attached the chambers to the temple.
He used beams of cedar to attach the chambers.
passages.original: וַיִּ֤בֶן אֶת־ הַיָּצוֹעַ עַל־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֔יִת חָמֵ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֽוֹמָת֑וֹ וַיֶּאֱחֹ֥ז אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִֽים׃פ

passages.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Solomon, saying: “As for this temple you are building, if you walk in My statutes, carry out My ordinances, and keep all My commandments by walking in them, I will fulfill through you the promise I made to your father David.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Solomon.
The LORD said these words to Solomon.
Solomon was building the temple.
The LORD said, “You are building this temple.
If you walk in My statutes,
If you do My ordinances,
If you keep all My commandments,
If you live by them,
Then I will fulfill My promise with you.
I spoke this promise to your father David.”
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃ הַבַּ֨יִת הַזֶּ֜ה אֲשֶׁר־ אַתָּ֣ה בֹנֶ֗ה אִם־ תֵּלֵ֤ךְ בְּחֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֣י תַּֽעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֥ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתַ֖י לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם וַהֲקִמֹתִ֤י אֶת־ דְּבָרִי֙ אִתָּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי אֶל־ דָּוִ֥ד אָבִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: And I will dwell among the Israelites and will not abandon My people Israel.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Solomon.
God made a promise.
God said, “I will live among the Israelites.
I will not leave My people Israel.”
passages.original: וְשָׁ֣כַנְתִּ֔י בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹ֥א אֶעֱזֹ֖ב אֶת־ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: So Solomon built the temple and finished it.
passages.sermon: Solomon was the king of Israel.\r\nSolomon built the temple.\r\nSolomon finished building the temple.
passages.original: וַיִּ֧בֶן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־ הַבַּ֖יִת וַיְכַלֵּֽהוּ׃

passages.text: He lined the interior walls with cedar paneling from the floor of the temple to the ceiling, and he covered the floor with cypress boards.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple for the Israelites.
He lined the inside walls with cedar panels.
He started at the floor and went up to the ceiling.
He covered the floor with cypress boards.
He used wood for the inside of the temple.
passages.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־ קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֤יִת מִבַּ֙יְתָה֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִקַּרְקַ֤ע הַבַּ֙יִת֙ עַד־ קִיר֣וֹת הַסִּפֻּ֔ן צִפָּ֥ה עֵ֖ץ מִבָּ֑יִת וַיְצַ֛ף אֶת־ קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת בְּצַלְע֥וֹת בְּרוֹשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: He partitioned off the twenty cubits at the rear of the temple with cedar boards from floor to ceiling to form within the temple an inner sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
\r\nSolomon built the temple for the LORD.
\r\nHe made a partition at the rear of the temple.
\r\nHe measured twenty cubits for this partition.
\r\nHe used cedar boards for the partition.
\r\nHe placed the cedar boards from the floor to the ceiling.
\r\nHe formed an inner sanctuary inside the temple.
\r\nThis inner sanctuary was called the Most Holy Place.
passages.original: וַיִּבֶן֩ אֶת־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים אַמָּ֜ה מִיַּרְכּוֹתֵי הַבַּ֙יִת֙ בְּצַלְע֣וֹת אֲרָזִ֔ים מִן־ הַקַּרְקַ֖ע עַד־ הַקִּיר֑וֹת וַיִּ֤בֶן לוֹ֙ מִבַּ֣יִת לִדְבִ֔יר לְקֹ֖דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: And the main hall in front of this room was forty cubits long.
passages.sermon: Solomon built the temple.\r\nThe main hall stood in front of the inner sanctuary.\r\nThe main hall was forty cubits long.
passages.original: וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים בָּאַמָּ֖ה הָיָ֣ה הַבָּ֑יִת ה֖וּא הַהֵיכָ֥ל לִפְנָֽי׃

passages.text: The cedar paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; not a stone could be seen.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple for the Lord.
He covered the inside walls with cedar wood.
Workers carved the cedar with shapes of gourds and open flowers.
They used cedar everywhere inside.
No stone was visible anywhere.
passages.original: וְאֶ֤רֶז אֶל־ הַבַּ֙יִת֙ פְּנִ֔ימָה מִקְלַ֣עַת פְּקָעִ֔ים וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים הַכֹּ֣ל אֶ֔רֶז אֵ֥ין אֶ֖בֶן נִרְאָֽה׃

passages.text: Solomon also prepared the inner sanctuary within the temple to set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built the temple in Jerusalem.
He prepared a special room inside the temple.
This room was called the inner sanctuary.
Solomon made this room ready for a purpose.
He set the ark of the covenant of the LORD there.
passages.original: וּדְבִ֧יר בְּתוֹךְ־ הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה הֵכִ֑ין לְתִתֵּ֣ן שָׁ֔ם אֶת־ אֲר֖וֹן בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and twenty cubits high. He overlaid the inside with pure gold, and he also overlaid the altar of cedar.
passages.sermon:
The inner sanctuary was inside the temple.
The inner sanctuary was a special room.
The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long.
The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits wide.
The inner sanctuary was twenty cubits high.
Solomon covered the inside of the inner sanctuary with pure gold.
Solomon also covered the altar, which was made of cedar, with gold.
passages.original: וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֡יר עֶשְׂרִים֩ אַמָּ֨ה אֹ֜רֶךְ וְעֶשְׂרִ֧ים אַמָּ֣ה רֹ֗חַב וְעֶשְׂרִ֤ים אַמָּה֙ קֽוֹמָת֔וֹ וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְצַ֥ף מִזְבֵּ֖חַ אָֽרֶז׃

passages.text: So Solomon overlaid the inside of the temple with pure gold, and he extended gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary, which was overlaid with gold.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built the temple for the LORD.
Solomon covered the inside of the temple with pure gold.
He put gold chains across the front of the inner sanctuary.
He covered the inner sanctuary with gold.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֨ף שְׁלֹמֹ֧ה אֶת־ הַבַּ֛יִת מִפְּנִ֖ימָה זָהָ֣ב סָג֑וּר וַיְעַבֵּ֞ר בְּרַתִּיקוֹת זָהָב֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וַיְצַפֵּ֖הוּ זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: So he overlaid with gold the whole interior of the temple, until everything was completely finished. He also overlaid with gold the entire altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He covered the entire inside of the temple with gold.
He continued covering with gold until every part was finished.
He also covered the altar that belonged to the inner sanctuary with gold.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַבַּ֛יִת צִפָּ֥ה זָהָ֖ב עַד־ תֹּ֣ם כָּל־ הַבָּ֑יִת וְכָל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֥חַ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ לַדְּבִ֖יר צִפָּ֥ה זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: In the inner sanctuary he made two cherubim, each ten cubits high, out of olive wood.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He made the inner sanctuary inside the temple.
He made two cherubim for the inner sanctuary.
He used olive wood to make the cherubim.
Each cherub was ten cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בַּדְּבִ֔יר שְׁנֵ֥י כְרוּבִ֖ים עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן עֶ֥שֶׂר אַמּ֖וֹת קוֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long, and the other wing was five cubits long as well. So the full wingspan was ten cubits.
passages.sermon:
A cherub is a special angelic being.
The first cherub had two wings.
One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long.
The other wing of the first cherub was also five cubits long.
The total length from the tip of one wing to the tip of the other wing was ten cubits.
passages.original: וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֗וֹת כְּנַ֤ף הַכְּרוּב֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וְחָמֵ֣שׁ אַמּ֔וֹת כְּנַ֥ף הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑ית עֶ֣שֶׂר אַמּ֔וֹת מִקְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָ֖יו וְעַד־ קְצ֥וֹת כְּנָפָֽיו׃

passages.text: The second cherub also measured ten cubits; both cherubim had the same size and shape, and the height of each cherub was ten cubits.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim were angelic figures.
Solomon placed two cherubim in the inner sanctuary of the temple.
The second cherub measured ten cubits tall.
The first cherub also measured ten cubits tall.
Both cherubim had the same size.
Both cherubim had the same shape.
Each cherub stood ten cubits high.
passages.original: וְעֶ֙שֶׂר֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה הַכְּר֖וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֑י מִדָּ֥ה אַחַ֛ת וְקֶ֥צֶב אֶחָ֖ד לִשְׁנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃ קוֹמַת֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הָֽאֶחָ֔ד עֶ֖שֶׂר בָּֽאַמָּ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן הַכְּר֥וּב הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

passages.text: And he placed the cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple. Since their wings were spread out, the wing of the first cherub touched one wall, while the wing of the second cherub touched the other wall, and in the middle of the room their wingtips touched.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He placed two cherubim inside the innermost room of the temple.
The cherubim spread out their wings.
The wing of the first cherub touched one wall.
The wing of the second cherub touched the opposite wall.
Their other wings reached toward the center of the room.
In the middle of the room, the tips of their wings touched each other.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן אֶת־ הַכְּרוּבִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ׀ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֗י וַֽיִּפְרְשׂוּ֮ אֶת־ כַּנְפֵ֣י הַכְּרֻבִים֒ וַתִּגַּ֤ע כְּנַף־ הָֽאֶחָד֙ בַּקִּ֔יר וּכְנַף֙ הַכְּר֣וּב הַשֵּׁנִ֔י נֹגַ֖עַת בַּקִּ֣יר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ הַבַּ֔יִת נֹגְעֹ֖ת כָּנָ֥ף אֶל־ כָּנָֽף׃

passages.text: He also overlaid the cherubim with gold.
passages.sermon: Solomon covered the cherubim with gold.\r\nHe placed gold over the cherubim.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ף אֶת־ הַכְּרוּבִ֖ים זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Then he carved the walls all around the temple, in both the inner and outer sanctuaries, with carved engravings of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple for the Lord.
He decorated the temple with great care.
He carved the walls all around the temple.
He carved both the inner sanctuary and the outer sanctuary.
He engraved images of cherubim on the walls.
He engraved palm trees on the walls.
He engraved open flowers on the walls.
passages.original: וְאֵת֩ כָּל־ קִיר֨וֹת הַבַּ֜יִת מֵסַ֣ב׀ קָלַ֗ע פִּתּוּחֵי֙ מִקְלְעוֹת֙ כְּרוּבִ֣ים וְתִֽמֹרֹ֔ת וּפְטוּרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים מִלִּפְנִ֖ים וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃

passages.text: And he overlaid the temple floor with gold in both the inner and outer sanctuaries.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple in Jerusalem.
He covered the floor of the temple with gold.
He put gold on the floor inside the inner sanctuary.
He also put gold on the floor in the outer sanctuary.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ קַרְקַ֥ע הַבַּ֖יִת צִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב לִפְנִ֖ימָה וְלַחִיצֽוֹן׃

passages.text: For the entrance to the inner sanctuary, Solomon constructed doors of olive wood with five-sided doorposts.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the entrance to the inner sanctuary.
He made doors for this entrance.
He used olive wood to make the doors.
He made the doorposts with five sides.
passages.original: וְאֵת֙ פֶּ֣תַח הַדְּבִ֔יר עָשָׂ֖ה דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן הָאַ֥יִל מְזוּז֖וֹת חֲמִשִֽׁית׃

passages.text: The double doors were made of olive wood, and he carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers and overlaid the cherubim and palm trees with hammered gold.
passages.sermon:
Solomon made two doors.
He used olive wood for these doors.
He carved cherubim into the doors.
He carved palm trees into the doors.
He carved open flowers into the doors.
He covered the doors with gold.
He put hammered gold over the cherubim.
He put hammered gold over the palm trees.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֮ דַּלְת֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שֶׁמֶן֒ וְקָלַ֣ע עֲ֠לֵיהֶם מִקְלְע֨וֹת כְּרוּבִ֧ים וְתִמֹר֛וֹת וּפְטוּרֵ֥י צִצִּ֖ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֑ב וַיָּ֛רֶד עַל־ הַכְּרוּבִ֥ים וְעַל־ הַתִּֽמֹר֖וֹת אֶת־ הַזָּהָֽב׃

passages.text: In the same way he made four-sided doorposts of olive wood for the sanctuary entrance.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
He built the temple in Jerusalem.
He made the entrance to the sanctuary.
He used olive wood for the doorposts.
The doorposts were four-sided.
passages.original: וְכֵ֥ן עָשָׂ֛ה לְפֶ֥תַח הַֽהֵיכָ֖ל מְזוּז֣וֹת עֲצֵי־ שָׁ֑מֶן מֵאֵ֖ת רְבִעִֽית׃

passages.text: The two doors were made of cypress wood, and each had two folding panels.
passages.sermon:
Solomon built the temple.
He made two doors.
He used cypress wood for the doors.
Each door had two folding panels.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּ֥י דַלְת֖וֹת עֲצֵ֣י בְרוֹשִׁ֑ים שְׁנֵ֨י צְלָעִ֜ים הַדֶּ֤לֶת הָֽאַחַת֙ גְּלִילִ֔ים וּשְׁנֵ֧י קְלָעִ֛ים הַדֶּ֥לֶת הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית גְּלִילִֽים׃

passages.text: He carved into them cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold, hammered evenly over the carvings.
passages.sermon:
Solomon carved designs into the doors.
He carved cherubim.
He carved palm trees.
He carved open flowers.
He covered the carvings with gold.
He hammered the gold evenly over the carved designs.
passages.original: וְקָלַ֤ע כְּרוּבִים֙ וְתִ֣מֹר֔וֹת וּפְטֻרֵ֖י צִצִּ֑ים וְצִפָּ֣ה זָהָ֔ב מְיֻשָּׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמְּחֻקֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Solomon built the inner courtyard with three rows of dressed stone and one row of trimmed cedar beams.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Solomon built the inner courtyard of the temple.
He used three rows of dressed stone.
He added one row of trimmed cedar beams.
passages.original: וַיִּ֙בֶן֙ אֶת־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית שְׁלֹשָׁ֖ה טוּרֵ֣י גָזִ֑ית וְט֖וּר כְּרֻתֹ֥ת אֲרָזִֽים׃

passages.text: The foundation of the house of the LORD was laid in the fourth year of Solomon’s reign, in the month of Ziv.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He began to build the house of the LORD.
He laid the foundation in the fourth year of his reign.
He started the work in the month of Ziv.
passages.original: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔ית יֻסַּ֖ד בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּיֶ֖רַח זִֽו׃

passages.text: In his eleventh year and eighth month, the month of Bul, the temple was finished in every detail and according to every specification. So he built the temple in seven years.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
He built the temple for the LORD.
He finished the temple in the eleventh year of his reign.
He finished it in the eighth month.
The eighth month is called Bul.
He completed the temple in every detail.
He followed every specification.
He built the temple in seven years.
passages.original: וּבַשָּׁנָה֩ הָאַחַ֨ת עֶשְׂרֵ֜ה בְּיֶ֣רַח בּ֗וּל ה֚וּא הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י כָּלָ֣ה הַבַּ֔יִת לְכָל־ דְּבָרָ֖יו וּלְכָל־ מִשְׁפָּטוֹ וַיִּבְנֵ֖הוּ שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִֽים׃
